reference_sql:
WITH weeks AS (
  -- one row per week, the weeks of 6 October to 29 December 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS week_start
  FROM range(DATE '2025-10-06', DATE '2026-01-05', INTERVAL 7 DAY)
), weekly AS (
  -- one row per week with app events
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', event_ts) AS DATE) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS events
  FROM app_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-06 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-05 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('week', event_ts) AS DATE)
)
SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(e.events, 0) AS events
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly e ON e.week_start = w.week_start

WITH weeks AS (
  -- one row per week, the weeks of 6 October to 29 December 2025
  SELECT CAST(generate_series AS DATE) AS week_start
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-10-06', DATE '2025-12-29', INTERVAL 7 DAY)
)
SELECT w.week_start, COUNT(e.event_id) AS events
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN app_events e ON CAST(date_trunc('week', e.event_ts) AS DATE) = w.week_start
GROUP BY w.week_start

solver.query:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS week_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-10-06', DATE '2025-12-29', INTERVAL 7 DAY) t(d)
), e AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS events
  FROM app_events
  WHERE (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
    AND (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-05 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT w.week_start, COALESCE(e.events, 0) AS events
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN e ON e.week_start = w.week_start
